head: codex/201-authority-protocol-preparation
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b1] Establish the quorum-committed authority protocol
body:
Closes #201

## Summary
- commit PrepareAuthority and FinalizeAuthority through production OpenRaft using actual applied log IDs and the exact stable replicated polis and membership authority
- keep the current boot cut runtime-external, require exact canonical equality for every Prepare, and freeze each prepared operation's historical boot custody plus digest
- retain opaque voter signer custody and runtime-owned per-node journal/CAS publication so apply returns pending until durable local reconciliation
- build and install snapshots immediately after boot rotation before a new Prepare, reject stale cuts without mutation, and reverify frozen historical finalization/publication evidence
- expose only sealed committed artifact and continuity projections while failing closed on legacy direct authority routes
- retain merge-safe v7 proof with an exact 86-case result contract and the complete Runtime denominator

## Validation
- exact authority and snapshot suite: 83/83 Rust cases
- semantic denominator: 86 selected = 11 passed, 6 reconciled, 69 rejected
- production snapshot matrix: 36/36
- full Runtime library: 230/230, zero skipped
- real three-voter OpenRaft prepare/finalize: 1/1
- legacy public-shape denial: 1/1
- strict production Clippy with warnings denied
- full-history, depth-one source-unavailable, and available-divergent validator modes
- typed validation and doctor PASS
- independent exact-head review: PASS, no actionable findings
